title: When the Inheritance Burns Revisited
author: Kestrel Thackeray
blurb: Gideon Vasquez, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
